'''0.14h''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that improved stability and connectivity.

==Changelog==
* Fixed a number of errors which caused the game to crash
* Fixed a bug when buying ammunition causing a loss of connection to the server
* Fixed sync error when reloading a shotgun and a sniper rifle
* Fixed a bug with the sound system (hissing at login menu
